snippet.title: DUCO - Trailer
snippet.description:
DUCO IS NOW ON STEAM!

Duco is a card-based survival roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic world. Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, loot, craft, build, and survive. Unlock new characters and maps, combine them with traits to create unique runs.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4872850/Duco/
